validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, independently confirmed. FERC docket CP25-89(-000) (companion abandonment docket CP25-90); FERC EA/FONSI issued 2025-08-27, FERC approved the certificate 2025-11 (Williams' own 10-Q: 'In November 2025, NWP received FERC approval for the project'; matches EIA Aug2026 release notes: 'FERC issued CP25-89 EIS 08/22/25 and conditional final order 11/20/25'). Independently tracked by EIA (Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook, every release 2025-07 through 2026-08) and Williams' own project page/SEC filings -- not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a natural-gas transmission expansion project (Fuel=Gas confirmed), not oil, not gathering/processing -- it converts an existing FERC-jurisdictional lateral and adds compression to move gas to/from NW Natural's North Mist underground storage. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate of any roster sibling. Distinguished from P0230 (NWP system row, 3,900 mi mainline), P2626 (Trail West/N-MAX, cancelled), P5101 (Kalama Lateral, cancelled) and P7812 (a wholly separate NWP expansion, 'Wild Trail' -- see cross_row_leads) by its own docket, its own capacity (183 MMcf/d / 183,400 Dth/d, vs P7812's 83), and its own OR/WA location. SPEC -- LengthKnown=0 mi is CORRECT despite EIA's project record and the 10-Q both citing an '17-18-mile' Kelso-Beaver pipeline: that mileage is the EXISTING pipeline NWP is ACQUIRING (from Portland General Electric / KB Pipeline Company / B-R Pipeline, purchased 2026-05 per the 10-Q), not new pipe. Williams' own project page states in plain words: 'The project does not involve new pipeline construction but focuses on upgrading existing infrastructure and access to natural gas storage.' The only new physical construction is a compressor station (5,500-HP electric-motor-driven KB Compressor Station near Kelso, Cowlitz County WA) and meter-station upgrades -- textbook 'expansion with no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown=0, Diameter blank' case, so the apparent EIA Miles=18 'differs' line is a scope match, not a sheet defect. Minor immaterial note: the 10-Q says the acquired pipe is 17 miles while EIA/Williams' page say 18 miles -- a rounding/vintage difference in describing the ACQUIRED pipe, irrelevant to LengthKnown since neither figure is new construction. Also noting for the record (not a GEM cell, no fill): Williams' project page still shows stale targets (Q3 2026 construction start target, Q3 2028 in-service target) that the more recent 2026-08 10-Q supersedes with Q4 2028 in-service; StartYear1=2028 is unaffected (year agrees across all sources) and no quarter-level cell exists to correct.
